## Backtest

```{python}
s, bm = bt["strategy"], bt["benchmark"]
st = perf_stats(s, 252)
stat_tiles([
    ("CAGR", pct(st["CAGR"]), "pos" if st["CAGR"] > 0 else "neg"),
    ("Volatility", pct(st["Volatility"], False), ""),
    ("Sharpe", f'{st["Sharpe"]:.2f}', ""),
    ("Max drawdown", pct(st["Max drawdown"], False), "neg"),
    ("Time in market", f'{meta()["gold"]["backtest_exposure"]:.0%}', ""),
])
```

<p class="asof">Daily, `{python} f"{bt.index[0]:%b %Y}"` to `{python} f"{bt.index[-1]:%b %Y}"`, on spot gold (XAU/USD). Before transaction costs. When the strategy is flat it holds cash, which earns the overnight fed funds rate (rate × days / 365). The benchmark is buy-and-hold gold.</p>

## How it works

::: {.method}
- **Universe:** gold, with the signal computed on spot gold (XAU/USD) and traded through a gold ETF (IAU). Long or flat only.
- **Core rule:** be long while the price is above its trend and the market is not in a band-breakdown (bear) regime. Otherwise stay flat.
- **Dynamic horizon:** when the price stretches far from its long-run trend, the model switches to a faster trend filter so it can cut risk sooner. It switches back once the price normalises.
- **Noise control:** in calm markets the signal is smoothed, and a new signal is locked for a few days so the model doesn't flip back and forth around the threshold. Large moves bypass the smoothing so exits stay fast.
- **Rebalance:** daily, at the close.
:::

:::
